nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances per address; mutated by _transferStandard and _takeTeam and used to derive real balances.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written in _approve and read in transferFrom.
Mapping of accounts exempt from buy/sell fees; set in constructor and by excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees.
Total reflection supply, reduced by _reflectFee on each taxed transfer and read by rate computation.
Accumulated token fees, increased by _reflectFee.
Block number recorded when trading is enabled; used to blacklist early sniper buyers.
Public blacklist mapping; set in constructor, blockBots, and automatically inside _transfer during the launch block.
Payable recipient of half of the swapped ETH fees and one of the two authorized manualswap/manualsend callers.
Payable recipient of half of the swapped ETH fees and the other authorized manualswap/manualsend caller.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps and pair creation.
Liquidity pair address created in the constructor; used to distinguish buys/sells in _transfer.
Flag gating transfers until the owner enables trading via setTrading.
Reentrancy-style lock toggled by the lockTheSwap modifier around swapTokensForEth.
Flag controlling whether automatic fee swapping is active; toggled by toggleSwap.
Maximum allowed transfer amount, owner-settable, also caps the swapped contract balance.
Maximum wallet balance enforced on non-pair recipients in _transfer.
Minimum contract token balance that triggers an automatic swap to ETH.
Ownable owner address, initialized from _msgSender() and used in the onlyOwner modifier.
Current redistribution fee percentage, switched between buy/sell values and zeroed by removeAllFee.
Current team/marketing fee percentage, switched between buy/sell values and zeroed by removeAllFee.
Declared per-address cooldown mapping that is never actually used in the logic.
Core transfer routine enforcing trading gate, max tx, blacklist, wallet cap, and triggering fee swaps and ETH distribution.
External ERC20 transfer entrypoint that calls _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
External ERC20 transferFrom entrypoint that moves tokens then decrements the caller allowance.
External ERC20 approve entrypoint delegating to _approve.
Internal allowance writer using the owner/spender zero-address checks.
Wrapper that disables fees for exempt transfers then calls _transferStandard and restores fees.
Applies reflection math to _rOwned, credits the team wallet, and reflects the fee.
Approves and swaps accumulated contract tokens for ETH on the Uniswap router under the lockTheSwap lock.
Splits the contract ETH balance and pushes it to the development and marketing addresses.
Permissioned manual trigger of swapTokensForEth, callable only by dev or marketing addresses.
Permissioned manual trigger of sendETHToFee, callable only by dev or marketing addresses.
Owner-only function enabling trading and recording launchBlock.
Owner-only batch blacklisting of addresses.
Owner-only removal of an address from the blacklist.
Owner-only setter of buy and sell redistribution and tax fee percentages.
Deployment routine minting reflection supply, setting up the router/pair, exclusions and initial blacklist.
Owner-only function setting _owner to the zero address.
Owner-only function transferring ownership to a non-zero address.
Read helper converting a reflection amount into a token amount using the current rate.
Computes reflection and token amounts, fees and team amounts for a transfer.
Returns current reflection and token supply used by the rate calculation.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal for each taxed transfer.
Credits the team/contract reflection balance with the team portion of the fee.
Caller address obtained through _msgSender(); drives ownership checks, allowance spenders and transfer senders.
Block timestamp used as the router swap deadline, making swap execution time dependent.
External call into the Uniswap router that swaps contract tokens for ETH and can interact with attacker-controlled pair/path.
Native ETH push via .transfer to the development and marketing addresses based on the live contract balance.
External call to the router factory that creates the token pair during construction.
Sender parameter of _transfer, checked against owner, blacklist, pair and exclusion lists.
Recipient parameter of _transfer, checked for pair, router, wallet cap and blacklist.
Transfer amount parameter of _transfer constrained by _maxTxAmount and non-zero checks.
Sender parameter of transferFrom whose allowance is consumed.
Recipient parameter of transferFrom passed down to _transfer.
Token amount parameter of swapTokensForEth that is approved and swapped.
Local flag in _transfer deciding whether fees are applied, forwarded to _tokenTransfer.
Local variable in _transfer holding balanceOf(address(this)) and triggering the swap.
Local swap path array [token, WETH] constructed in swapTokensForEth.
Parameter of transferOwnership validated as non-zero before assigning _owner.
ETH amount parameter of sendETHToFee split between development and marketing addresses.

edges.reason: _msgSender() is used as the 'from' address of _transfer in transfer and transferFrom.
_msgSender() is used as the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom.
_msgSender() is used as the owner address in approve.
manualswap is authorized by comparing _msgSender() to the dev and marketing addresses.
manualsend is authorized by comparing _msgSender() to the dev and marketing addresses.
setTrading is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier which compares _owner with _msgSender().
renounceOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
_owner is initialized and reassigned from _msgSender(), controlling all privileged setters.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency and swap front-running surface.
transfer delegates token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_transfer ends by invoking _tokenTransfer with the computed takeFee flag.
_tokenTransfer performs the actual reflection accounting through _transferStandard.
_transferStandard derives all amounts from _getValues.
_getValues obtains the current rate which is computed from _getCurrentSupply.
tokenFromReflection relies on _getCurrentSupply through _getRate for balanceOf.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when the contract balance and swap conditions are met.
_transfer sends the resulting contract ETH balance to the fee wallets via sendETHToFee.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the contract ETH balance.
_transferStandard applies the fee reduction through _reflectFee.
_transferStandard credits the team share through _takeTeam.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal, adjusting the rate used everywhere.
_reflectFee accumulates token fees into _tFeeTotal.
_takeTeam increases _rOwned of the contract with the team portion.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection amounts in _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_approve writes the allowance into _allowances.
transferFrom reads and updates _allowances for the spender allowance check.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee handling and swap eligibility.
_transfer consults swapEnabled before triggering a swap.
_transfer checks the inSwap lock to avoid nested swaps.
_transfer compares the contract token balance with _swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swapping.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount and caps the swapped balance.
_transfer enforces the wallet balance cap using _maxWalletSize.
_transfer reads bots[from]/bots[to] and writes bots[to] for early buyers from the pair.
_transfer compares block.number with launchBlock, making blacklisting dependent on the launch state.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to classify buys and sells.
_transfer references the router address when excluding router transfers from fees.
setTrading writes the tradingOpen flag.
setTrading records launchBlock = block.number, controlling the sniper blacklist window.
blockBots adds entries to the bots blacklist.
unblockBot clears an entry in the bots blacklist.
setFee writes buy/sell redistribution fee values used by _redisFee.
setFee writes buy/sell tax fee values used by _taxFee.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0), forever disabling owner-only controls.
transferOwnership assigns _owner to the new address.
constructor mints the entire reflection supply to _msgSender().
constructor configures the Uniswap router address.
constructor stores the created uniswapV2Pair address.
constructor marks owner, contract, dev and marketing as fee-excluded.
constructor pre-blacklists a hardcoded list of sniper addresses.
sendETHToFee pushes half of the ETH to _developmentAddress.
sendETHToFee pushes half of the ETH to _marketingAddress.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call on the token/WETH path.
the lockTheSwap modifier toggles inSwap around the router interaction.
the external swap transfers ETH and can re-enter token transfer logic before inSwap is reset, so state must be consistent at call time.
sendETHToFee performs native ETH .transfer calls to the two fee wallets.
constructor calls the factory to create the trading pair.
tokenFromReflection converts _rOwned[account] into a token balance for balanceOf.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to compute the reflection supply.
_getValues depends on the rate derived from _rTotal when computing reflection amounts.

normalization_plan.reason: 'from' is a parameter of _transfer and should be folded into that core function node for analysis.
'to' is a parameter of _transfer and is only meaningful within that function's checks.
'amount' is a parameter of _transfer constrained by _maxTxAmount and zero checks.
'sender' is a parameter of transferFrom and is folded into that function node.
'recipient' is a parameter of transferFrom forwarded to _transfer.
'tokenAmount' is the parameter of swapTokensForEth that is approved and swapped.
'takeFee' is a local flag in _transfer consumed directly by _tokenTransfer.
'contractTokenBalance' is a local variable of _transfer driving the swap decision.
'path' is a local array of swapTokensForEth used only for the router call.
'newOwner' is the parameter of transferOwnership and merges into that function node.
'amount_' is the parameter of sendETHToFee split between the two fee wallets.
